name: Mukhyamantri Aanchal Amrit Yojana
benefit: Under this scheme, children between 3 to 6 years of age are provided fortified and flavored milk enriched with Vitamins A and D, four days a week.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a child between 3 and 6 years of age.
